name: MaterializedWindow UTC starts_at and ends_at must equal the checked tzdb 2025b resolution of start_local_at and end_local_at under the pinned timezone and dst_policy, forming a proper interval.

payload.rationale: MaterializedWindow UTC starts_at and ends_at must equal the checked tzdb 2025b resolution of start_local_at and end_local_at under the pinned timezone and dst_policy, forming a proper interval.

response.expression: (((self.tzdb_version == '2025b') and (timestamp(self.starts_at) == resolve_local_timestamp(self.start_local_at, self.timezone, self.dst_policy))) and (timestamp(self.ends_at) == resolve_local_timestamp(self.end_local_at, self.timezone, self.dst_policy))) and (timestamp(self.starts_at) < timestamp(self.ends_at))

payload.subject: time.MaterializedWindow
